none: PAS PUBLIC-535FCE: PUBLIC-535FCE: A Roman silver denarius of Tiberius
contea di ritrovamento: County of Herefordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman silver coin: a denarius of Tiberius dating from AD 14 - 37 (Reece period 1). Reverse legend PONTIF MAXIM. The reverse depicts a female figure, seated right on a chair with ornate legs, holding a sceptre and olive branch, a single line below. Mint of Lyon. Reference: RIC I (revised edition), p. 95, no. 30. Weight: 3.2 gms Diameter: 18.7 mm
